{{Quote|I know your name, and those of your companions, because you have been tearing through the space between Hutt Space and the Corporate Sector, discomforting a lot of my normal clients.|Morga Bunna, to Mander Zuma|<ref name="Scourge" />}}
'''Morga Bunna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bosph (species)|Bosph]] who lived during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Bunna worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], but later retired and established a [[Morga Bunna's supply depot|depot]] on [[Bosph's outermost moon|one]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bosph/Legends|Bosph]], which served as a cache point for illicit items.

In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], supplies of the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Tempest (spice)|Tempest]] were stored in Bunna's facility by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera]]. Bunna had the Tempest removed after the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] began shutting down the Tempest trade. Bunna's depot was later raided by Zumma and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] arrived moments later, and Bunna was forced to surrender to them. Bunna shared his knowledge of the Tempest trade with Zuma and in return for his honesty, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] instructed the CSA to not detain the Bosph.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Welcome to my humble shop. Are you the Jedi called Mander Zuma?|Morga Bunna, to Mander Zuma|<ref name="Scourge" />}}
Morga Bunna was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bosph (species)|Bosph]] who lived during the era of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. After making a living as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and traveling across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Bunna retired and set up a [[Morga Bunna's supply depot|depot]] on the [[Bosph's outermost moon|outermost moon]] of the [[Bosph/Legends|Bosph homeworld]] for storing stolen goods. The small [[Moon/Legends|moon]] was desolate and far from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Bosph, and Bunna's facility served both as a place for criminals to cache illicit goods and a trading post for individuals who wished to sell their wares without meeting buyers face to face. To protect the anonymity of Bunna's customers, all deliveries to his depot were arranged through blind drops with shipping schedules changing regularly. Over [[Time/Legends|time]], Bunna burrowed through moon to expand his depot and he built a number of halls, passages, storage rooms, as well as a translucent pleasure dome along one side.<ref name="Scourge" />

Around [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], Bunna agreed to a number of contracts to store [[Tempest (spice)|Tempest]], a new potent form of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] produced by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera]] that left users prone to violent fits of rage. However, after the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] began disrupting the Tempest supply chain across [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] in an attempt to trace the source of the spice, Bunna sent on all of the Tempest stored at his depot and refused to accept any more shipments of the spice.<ref name="Scourge" />

To defend against any possible attack by Zuma, a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] were sent to Bunna's facility by [[Anjiliac|Mika's crime syndicate]], with orders to help the Bosph wherever they could with defending his depot. Three [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later, Zuma arrived in the [[Bosph system/Legends|Bosph system]] aboard the [[TL-1200 transport/Legends|TL-1200 transport]] ''[[New Ambition]]'' after having traced a shipment of Tempest he had found on the planet [[Budpock]] back to Bunna's depot. Using a communications channel that only Bunna's clients had been provided details of, the ''New Ambition'' hailed the Bosph and requested a meeting. Bunna correctly guessed that Mander Zuma was aboard the [[Starship|ship]] and he agreed to the request and granted the vessel permission to land.<ref name="Scourge" />

Bunna met with Zuma and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master's]] associates, the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Reen Irana]] and the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Eddey Be'ray]], inside a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] dome at the heart of the Bunna's depot. The Bosph introduced himself and confirmed to Zuma that Tempest had recently been stored at the depot, and he provided Zuma with a [[Data cube/Legends|data cube]] that contained notes of his recent transactions.<ref name="Scourge" />

Bunna declined a request from Zuma to supply details of who had shipped the Tempest to his depot as he did not no their identity, and he did not yield any further information after Zuma attempted to use a Jedi [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on him. To resist any further attempt by Zuma to discover more about the origins of Tempest, Bunna summoned out the mercenaries that Mika had sent, who emerged with their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] aimed at the Jedi. Bunna implored Zuma, Irana and Be'ray to return to their ship and leave, but Zuma refused and moments later the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser|''Invincible''-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser]] [[Resolute (Invincible-class)|''Resolute'']] arrived at the moon. The CSA ship had been assisting Zuma with his efforts to disrupt the Tempest supply chain and it sent landing forces to raid Zuma's depot.<ref name="Scourge" />

The CSA forces found a number of items stolen from Corporate Sector citizens among the contents of Bunna's depot, but Zuma stepped in to stop them from taking the Bosph into custody because the Bosph had been open and honest in his dealings with the Jedi Master. At Reen Irana's request, Bunna supplied her with information on the location of [[Hedu]], the [[Matriarch/Legends|matriarch]] of a [[Bomu Clan|Rodian clan]] that had been involved in the distribution of Tempest, and confirmed that the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] leader could be found on the planet [[Dennogra/Legends|Dennogra]]. Zuma, Irana and Be'ray then departed Bunna's facility and ventured to Dennogra to track down the Rodian matriarch.<ref name="Scourge" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|He was straightforward with us.|Mander Zuma, on Morga Bunna's honesty about the presence of Tempest on his depot|<ref name="Scourge" />}}
Bunna considered Mander Zuma's campaign against the Tempest trade as both good and bad for business, as it prompted some customers to withdraw their wares from his facility, while it led others to transfer their goods to the safety of the Bosph's supply depot. During his encounter with Mander Zuma, rather than resist the Jedi, Bunna sought to keep his exchange with the Jedi Master as brief as possible by being open and honest about what information he possessed on the Tempest trade.<ref name="Scourge" />

Bunna wore opulent robes and<ref name="Scourge" /> as was common for members of his [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="AE">{{JournalCite|13|Alien Encounters (article series)}}</ref> his four [[Limb/Legends|arms]] were inscribed with [[Star map/Legends|star maps]] depicting his travels. He also had two slender [[Horn/Legends|horns]] atop his head that were tipped with [[Gold/Legends|gold]].<ref name="Scourge" />

==Behind the scenes==
Morga Bunna was created by [[Jeff Grubb]] and appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']].<ref name="Scourge" />
